summary: CIM Real Estate Finance Trust, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting the closing of a multi-step acquisition of Legacy CIM's real assets management business and investment portfolio. The registrant formed a new operating partnership (New OP), contributed all its equity interests in its existing operating partnership and other material assets/liabilities, while CIM Group Holdings contributed all equity of CIM Group Management, LLC and CIM Group Investments, LLC plus $1,000 cash to New OP in exchange for newly issued Class A LP units with equal economic rights. Terms were not disclosed for price per share or premium. No board recommendation or break fee was specified. The transaction closed June 24, 2026; watch for regulatory filings and integration risks.
